strategy.primary: Exile theft into compact Grixis wins: library-exile effects (Extract, Tasha's Hideous Laughter, Ashiok, Jester's Cap) become tutors and card draw under the Jester's play permission, protected by free counters, and the deck closes with Thassa's Oracle + Demonic Consultation / Tainted Pact or Underworld Breach + Brain Freeze.
strategy.secondary: Cast-from-exile payoffs (Dragon's Smile, Prosper, Gonti, Laughing Jasper Flint) and the Jester's attack trigger (hasty with Greaves) for incremental stolen resources.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: The Madcap Jester
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Whenever The Madcap Jester attacks, each opponent exiles the top card of their library.
Whenever a spell or ability you control causes one or more cards to be exiled from an opponent's library, you may play those cards until the end of your next turn. Mana of any type can be spent to cast spells this way.

identity.why: Plays cards exiled from opponents' libraries.

future_release.official_commander_legality: not legal until 2026-11-13 (Wizards: new-to-Magic MBC cards are legal from 2026-11-13)
